paragraphs: I administer and configure enterprise CRM platforms for banking and financial services teams. My work covers user and license management, workflows, custom fields, page layouts, record types, dashboards and reports.
At JPMC I manage access for 300+ users. Configuration changes I delivered there improved operational efficiency by 30%, and my troubleshooting work reduced CRM-related incidents by 35%.
At HCL Technologies I configured workflows, dashboards and reports that increased user adoption by 25%. I also supported data migration and cleansing work that reached 98% data accuracy.
I work closely with business users, QA teams and vendors on requirements, UAT and documentation. I'm now aiming my reporting and data skills at data analyst work.
